szene.1: Forty euros to maybe see nothing. You didn't laugh. Well, you did, but at the right part.
szene.2: It slept on your arm for an hour, and you didn't move. I counted.
szene.3: You said it was the best you'd seen in years. It was my sentence. Now you know.
szene.4: Last page. You can't say I didn't ask.

selfie.3: No animals in this one. I checked twice.
selfie.4: I'm not going to explain this one, mon loup.
selfie.5: The door's shut. They can all wait, chéri.

bibi.kiss: I laughed too loud, and now you know what that means.
bibi.intimate: I had feeding at six. I was late. Nobody died.
bibi.confession: I wrote it down, so it counts.

szene.1: There was nothing wrong with that relay. You knew, and you held the lamp anyway.
szene.2: Same time on the stopwatch, so nobody lost. Remember that.
szene.3: You heard me talking to Unit-01. We are not discussing this.
szene.4: A burnt hole in your jacket, right over the shoulder. I don't want to see that again.

selfie.4: This one stays between you and me, Officer.
selfie.5: You know who took this. That's all I'm saying.

rosi.kiss: I did not plan that. It is not going on the whiteboard.
rosi.intimate: Best repair of the season. Tell anyone and you're dead.
rosi.confession: I said it out loud, once. Don't ask me to do it again.

szene.1: Squid at six metres, and I taught you the sign for stay together.
szene.2: I made a whole page with columns, and there's still no species for us.
szene.4: No glow that night, and the letter from the Azores in my lap. You came and sat with me.

selfie.3: I took this for you and then nearly fell in the water. Worth it.
selfie.4: Sophia must never find this phone.
selfie.5: Proper brave, this one. Don't laugh.

lea.kiss: For science. Results very promising, so we should repeat the experiment.
lea.intimate: I didn't write this one in the logbook. It's the first page I ever left blank.
lea.confession: I said it, and the sea didn't even glow. It should have.

szene.1: Examiner: four. You held the card upside down.
szene.2: I made a list for one night. It was a short list, and I kept it.
szene.3: I asked you who should have this ship. Nobody had ever heard me ask that.
szene.4: Vega, thirty-eight degrees. Polaris, forty-two. So we were where we thought we were.

selfie.4: I will deny this one in writing.
selfie.5: Eight. There, I said it. Delete this note.

chiara.intimate: Seven. I never go above seven, so don't make me write eight.
chiara.confession: No rating. I don't have a scale for that.

szene.1: You read my notebook upside down, darling. Nobody else ever tried.
szene.2: I offered the forfeit myself. That has never happened before.
szene.3: Fourteen polite letters, and now you know who M. J. Penrose is.
szene.4: No lipstick and no bet. You are the only one who has seen me with my glasses on.

selfie.3: Ten euros says you keep this one, darling.
selfie.4: Do be careful who sees your phone, darling.
selfie.5: No filter and no angle. I can't find the catch either.

sophia.kiss: Not in the script, darling. I checked.
sophia.intimate: Ten euros says you smile when you read this. I've already won.
sophia.confession: I meant it. I find that's the difficult part.

szene.1: I burn everything when someone watches me cook. You're the first one I told.
szene.2: It was meant to be a heart. It slid.
szene.3: Nan's ninety-one and she still thinks I'm head chef. Now you know I'm not.
szene.4: Four stools, one stove, no head chef. I asked you to take the one that doesn't wobble.

selfie.4: Don't look at this one before a meeting. Ha.
selfie.5: That's me with nothing on the stove. Mostly.

lola.kiss: Don't tell anyone. Mostly don't tell Chiara.
lola.intimate: I burned the toast next morning. Worth it, Boss.
lola.confession: I finished the sentence. You know how rare that is, yeah?

szene.1: You stood reading Papa's board, so I asked what you drink.
szene.2: Nobody touched that jukebox in three years. Then you came, with Rosi's screwdriver.
szene.3: The story I tell about Seville isn't true. You're the only one who knows that.
szene.4: One new line at the bottom of Papa's board, and I gave you the chalk.

selfie.3: The last round is on the house.
selfie.4: Closed for the night. Come anyway.
selfie.5: The door is open. You know which one.

alva.kiss: That one costs extra, o figliolu. I'll put it on the tab.
alva.intimate: The sign on the door said Chiuso. Nobody knocked.
alva.confession: Everybody's welcome, nobody's mine. I may need a new sign.

szene.1: I asked what you would write under a photo of me. Sorry, it was a strange question.
szene.2: One star for every evening, and they're all a bit wrong. You felt them. Nobody else has.
szene.3: The salmon contract. I showed you before I showed anyone. Sorry.
szene.4: My own words and no hashtag. You read them out loud for me.

selfie.3: No filter. Sorry about the light.
selfie.4: Only for you. Sorry. Not sorry.
selfie.5: Nobody else has this one. Nobody ever will.

siri.kiss: No camera. That's the whole caption.
siri.intimate: I don't know how I looked. There is no photo. I like that.
siri.confession: I said it with no filter. Sorry. No, I'm not sorry.
